  • Method Details

    • applyEffect

      boolean applyEffect(GameState state, Age age)
      Core event logic — each concrete effect implements only this. Players are retrieved from state.getOrderTileOrder(). Must NOT trigger buildings; that's handled by the template method.
      Parameters:
      state - the current game state
      age - the age in which the event resolves
      Returns:
      true if the effect was applied

    • executeEffect

      default boolean executeEffect(GameState state, TriggerKey triggerKey, Age age)
      Template method: executes the event effect, then publishes the corresponding trigger so that matching buildings are activated. Concrete classes should NOT override this.
      Parameters:
      state - the current game state
      triggerKey - the trigger to publish after the effect runs
      age - the age in which the event resolves
      Returns:
      true if the effect was applied and the trigger published, false if any argument is null or the effect failed
